card.title: Galaxy A14 5g (A146B) No BackLight

claims.statement: On Galaxy A146B, a blown fusible coil in the LED_ANODE line leaves no diode reading on the display connector anode; it can be bypassed.
The backlight diode should not beep and should not read the same both sides (LED_ANODE vs VPH_PWR).
Expected voltages: VPH_PWR 3.7–4.2 V, LED_ANODE 3.7–4.2 V, LED cathode 0 V.
Most common fault: LED_ANODE line goes open under load though it reads normal at rest; a jumper from the anode side of the diode to the display connector anode fixes it.

procedure: Look for leaked components near the coils.
Check outputs for shorts; check/bypass the fusible coil.
If anode reading changes when pressing near the BL IC, jumper LED_ANODE from the diode to the connector and UV mask.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
